name: Quietly AI

pricing.summary: Free starter (8 questions), Premium $7.99/month with 3-day trial, Pro $14.99/month

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 8 questions total, do not reset monthly; no account needed to try

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Unlimited questions; 3-day free trial then billed monthly

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Routes to stronger AI models; priority access; includes Premium features

featuresStated: Auto-detects quiz questions on page
Step-by-step explanations and hints
Ask Quietly: select text to explain/summarize/make notes in a sidebar
Chat for questions, studying, summarizing, writing (Premium/Pro)
Automatic routing to stronger AI model (Pro)
notes: Chrome Web Store (checked): 4.6 from 11 ratings, ~2,000 users. Site also claims '100,000+ questions processed in May' (unverified site claim). Home page redirects to www. Site frames product as a learning aid and has an 'Honor Code' page; no undetectable claim seen.

name: Canvas Ninja
featuresStated: Privacy Guard (controls focus/visibility signals on supported quiz pages)
Answer Saver (uses saved submission history for supported retakes)
Smart Answers (optional AI help)
notes: Main positioning is tab-switch/quiz-log privacy (Chrome Web Store title: 'Tab Detection Blocker for Canvas'), so classified activity-hiding. Site text explicitly disclaims that it proves undetectability, so claimsUndetectable=false; a human may want to review. CWS: 5.0 from 5 ratings, ~739 users (checked). Installing is free; features need a paid plan per site FAQ.

name: Test Bro

pricing.summary: 5 free asks/month; one-time credit packs $2.99 (200), $3.99 (400), $5.99 (800), each valid 1 month, no subscription

featuresStated: Highlight text, right-click and ask AI
Select a screen area for AI analysis (images or non-selectable text)
One-click answer on supported platforms (availability varies by site)
notes: CWS (checked): 4.1 from 32 ratings, ~9,000 users. No specific LMS/platform list on home page. No undetectable claim seen.

name: FastSolve

plans.name: Pro Semester
plans.notes: Described as a 4-month semester; appears in FAQ and comparison table, not in main pricing cards

featuresStated: Double-click a question to get an answer
Fills answer into input field
Automatic AI model selection by subject
Supports multiple-choice, essay, fill-in-the-blank, matching
Unlimited questions on Pro plans
notes: Site markets itself as undetectable/invisible (claimsUndetectable=true). Unverified site claims: '98% accuracy', 'under 2 seconds'. Site says CWS rating 4.4 from 20 ratings; CWS page fetched shows 4.1 from 27 ratings and ~5,000 users (CWS value is the checked one). Site is inconsistent on AI models (Gemini Flash/Claude Sonnet in one place, Claude + GPT-4o in FAQ/plan text). Main pricing cards omit the Semester plan. Extension stated to be unusable in Respondus LockDown Browser.

name: Coursology

pricing.summary: Paid only on pricing page: $24.99/month, or $12.50/month on a 12-month plan (listed as 50% off)

plans.name: 12 Months
plans.notes: Listed as -50% off $24.99/month; total billing structure (upfront vs monthly) not stated on page

platformsStated: Stated as working on any learning platform / LMS
featuresStated: Instant Answers (snap or click a question)
Study tools: quizzes and flashcards from uploaded materials
AI podcasts and lecture recorder with notes
Discussion post drafter, humanizer and essay drafting
iPhone and Android app
notes: /pricing redirects to /pro. Sold as an all-in-one study suite but also markets instant answers, discussion-post drafting, a 'humanizer' for AI text, and essay writing; classification as study-tools is a judgment call. No Chrome Web Store link found in the HTML (extension store URL not verified); site says 'Add to Chrome'. Unverified site claims: '1M+ students', 4.8 from 4.4K App Store ratings. No free tier or trial stated on fetched pages (may exist behind signup).
